{{Quote|Thank you for rescuing me. I am truly in your debt. Forgive me, but I must get out of here quickly. Thank you again.|Hetl Darkrunner, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Hetl Darkrunner''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who operated out of the [[Death Watch bunker|Death Watch Bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ScientistNPCTemplate.png|250px|thumb|All possible depictions of Hetl Darkrunner]]
Hetl Darkrunner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" />
